name: adobos-bot
description: Bot de Discord modular y panel web self-hosted — monorepo Adobos

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @adobos/shared build && pnpm --filter @adobos/frontend build && pnpm --filter @adobos/backend build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const s='frontend/dist';const d='backend/public';fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('Panel estático → backend/public')"
